       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS merchandise_value_dollars

GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

       SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c

JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.country, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS spent_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, spent_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spent_minor DESC) AS spend_rank
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT country AS country_code, name AS customer_name,
       spent_minor / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spend_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name;

    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(o.delivered_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(o.placed_at))), 2) AS avg_delivery_days

GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

    o.id AS order_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
FROM orders AS o

ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, o.id ASC;

SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor))
        / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
        2
    ) AS discount_pct
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS merchandise_value_dollars
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id

WHERE c.name = 'Mona Park'
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM refunds AS r
    WHERE r.order_id = o.id
      AND r.amount_minor > 0
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS refunded_percentage
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete';

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.country, c.id, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS spent_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, spent_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spent_minor DESC) AS spending_rank
    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       spent_minor / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spending_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name;

FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(oi.order_id) >= 25;

SELECT
    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(o.delivered_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(o.placed_at))), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

    c.name AS customer_name,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting

SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor))
        / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
        2
    ) AS discount_percentage
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS merchandise_value_dollars
FROM orders AS o

GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete';

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.country, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS spent_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT country, name, spent_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY spent_minor DESC) AS spending_rank
    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       spent_minor / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE spending_rank = 1
ORDER BY country_code, customer_name;

    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(o.delivered_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(o.placed_at))), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders AS o

  AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

       c.name AS customer_name,
       CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'in_transit'
  AND date(o.placed_at) < date('2026-06-30', '-120 days')
ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, order_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * (p.price_minor - oi.unit_price_minor))
        / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price_minor), 0),
        2
    ) AS discount_pct
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category;

FROM products AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id
      AND o.status = 'canceled'
);
